# Immutable synthetic article regression fixture

Copied byte for byte from the controlled synthetic P/S article experiment on
2026-10-10. `model-output.txt` is the frozen model text (SHA-256
`9776fb2b6e9788f0d6198f4bce4ebb59d19bb5b348619b3098d6bc33ad08d179`).
The other three files are its original native inputs. No response envelope,
credentials or customer data are included. The original archive is unchanged.

This tests mechanical parsing, numeric grounding and reference integrity only.
Article quality remains **NOT_APPROVED**, independent human review **NOT_SIGNED**,
production **NO-GO**, PostgreSQL **BLOCKED**. A passing replay is not authorization
to generate another article, create a commercial draft or write to WordPress.
